name: Uenohara (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Uenohara city emblem in orange, light blue and green: orange and light blue stylised strokes above a green curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Uenohara, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 October 2005.
